definitions.explanation: A severe snowstorm with strong winds and heavy snowfall that reduces visibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{吹雪|ふぶき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えなかった→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't see ahead because of the severe blizzard.

examples.japanese: {吹雪|ふぶき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠航|けっこう}→欠航：09509_kekkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The flight was canceled due to the blizzard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{吹雪|ふぶき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}って→遭う：09500_au⟧、⟦{遭難|そうなん}→遭難：09510_sounan⟧⟦しかけた→仕掛ける：04243_shikakeru⟧。
examples.english: We got caught in a blizzard in the mountains and almost got lost.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Combines ⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (to blow) and ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ (snow), literally "blowing snow." The rendaku changes ゆき to ぶき.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {吹雪|ふぶき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to get caught in a blizzard
- {吹雪|ふぶき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あ}れる→荒れる：04577_areru⟧: the blizzard rages
- ⟦{猛|もう}→猛：noentry⟧{吹雪|ふぶき}: fierce blizzard
- {吹雪|ふぶき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{視界|しかい}→視界：14137_shikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no visibility due to a blizzard

RELATED WEATHER TERMS:
- ⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧: heavy snow (without necessarily strong wind)
- ⟦{暴風雪|ぼうふうせつ}→暴風雪：27315_boufuusetsu⟧: blizzard (formal meteorological term, used in weather forecasts)
- ⟦{地吹雪|じふぶき}→地吹雪：20486_jifubuki⟧: ground blizzard (wind-driven snow along the ground)

USAGE:
Common in weather reports and news about northern Japan, especially Hokkaido and the Tohoku region. Also used figuratively: ⟦{桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}→桜吹雪：13137_sakurafubuki⟧ (a shower of cherry blossoms).
